project_description: Persian-language, fully RTL healthcare web app (Master's thesis, Health IT) for self-management and longitudinal health information management of adult patients with differentiated thyroid cancer (papillary/follicular) after thyroid surgery in follow-up.

headlines.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-snug

colors.theme_archetype: Organic Health & Precision Clinical (Earthy Emerald & Slate)
colors.rule: Never use pure #000000. Tint all neutrals with slight slate blue tones.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

disclaimer_banner.text_fa: ⚠️ توجه ویژه: این سامانه یک ابزار تشخیصی، تفسيري یا تجویزی نیست و جایگزین توصیه‌های پزشک معالج شما نمی‌باشد. این پلتفرم صرفاً جهت ثبت و مدیریت اطلاعات سلامت شخصی طراحی شده است.
disclaimer_banner.style: bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-3

component_instructions.app_shell: Include top bar with branding, role badge, role quick switcher for demo ease, Jalali current date header display, theme switcher, and persistent Medical Disclaimer banner.
component_instructions.patient_dashboard: Feature medical profile overview card (Thyroid cancer type: Papillary/Follicular, Surgery date in Jalali, RAI history, Staging text TNM, Emergency contact). Display grid of 'Coming Soon' (به‌زودی) feature cards for Medications, Labs (TSH/FT4/Tg/Anti-Tg), Appointments, Symptoms, Timeline, Documents, Education.
component_instructions.patient_profile: Tabbed interface with 'اطلاعات فردی' (Personal Info) and 'پرونده سرطان تیروئید' (Thyroid Cancer Profile). Form fields in Persian with validation and clear RTL layout.
component_instructions.physician_dashboard: Searchable list of assigned patients with quick filters, status badges, and expandable/modal read-only view of patient's detailed medical profile.
component_instructions.admin_dashboard: Tabbed management for: 1) Approval Queue (Pending Patient Registrations approve/reject), 2) User Management (Patients & Physicians status enable/disable), 3) Doctor Registration (Create Physician), 4) Doctor-Patient Assignment.
component_instructions.pending_state: Friendly Persian pending approval banner for newly registered patients explaining that admin approval is required before accessing full medical features.

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rule: ALL interactive and key data elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="patient-profile-save-button", data-testid="admin-approve-patient-btn").
accessibility_and_testing.font_rendering: Apply Vazirmatn font globally via index.html and Tailwind config.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set dir='rtl' on parent containers or document body.
Ensure all Lucide icons are appropriately flipped for RTL if directional (e.g., ChevronRight/Left, ArrowRight/Left).
Include data-testid on all buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, badges, and table rows.
Do not use external AI emojis; use Lucide React icons.
Support Jalali date formats in Persian numbers/text.
